from.place: The final continuous-cochain comparison clause: the coinduced contraction identity

title: The coinduced contraction satisfies the homotopy identity
statement: Let $G$ be a profinite group, $A$ a finite ring, and $M$ a left $A$-module with an action of $G$ by $A$-linear automorphisms such that every element has open stabilizer [lem-exc-discrete-modules-abelian]. Give $M$ the discrete topology and put $D(M)=\operatorname{Cont}(G,M)$ with the discrete topology and the action $(h\cdot f)(x)=f(xh)$ [lem-exc-coinduced-discrete-embedding]. For $n\geq0$ put $C^n(G,D(M))=\operatorname{Cont}(G^n,D(M))$. The inhomogeneous differentials are $d^0v(g)=g\cdot v-v$ and, for $n\geq1$, $d^nF(g_1,\ldots,g_{n+1})=g_1\cdot F(g_2,\ldots,g_{n+1})+\sum_{j=1}^n(-1)^jF(g_1,\ldots,g_jg_{j+1},\ldots,g_{n+1})+(-1)^{n+1}F(g_1,\ldots,g_n)$. For $n\geq1$ set $h_n(F)(g_1,\ldots,g_{n-1})(x)=F(x,g_1,\ldots,g_{n-1})(1)$; this is a continuous cochain by [lem-exc-coinduced-homotopy-continuous]. Then for every $n\geq1$ and $F\in C^n(G,D(M))$, one has $d^{n-1}h_nF+h_{n+1}d^nF=F$ as an equality of continuous cochains.

source.place: Tag 0DVG, label section-continuous-group-cohomology, final profinite comparison (the contraction identity is an agent-written proof ingredient)

proof.text: Fix n>=1, F, and (g_1,...,g_n) in G^n. Evaluate both cochains at x in G. Substituting the definition of h_n into d^{n-1} (including the n=1 formula d^0) and using the coinduced action gives the first term as the alternating sum whose leading term is F(xg_1,g_2,...,g_n)(1), whose interior terms are -F(x,g_1g_2,...,g_n)(1), ..., and whose final term is (-1)^nF(x,g_1,...,g_{n-1})(1). The cited continuity lemma ensures that h_nF is an allowed continuous cochain, while the coinduced-action formula justifies the translation in the leading term.

source.place: Tag 0DVG, label section-continuous-group-cohomology; direct expansion of the inhomogeneous differential

proof.text: With the same tuple and x, expand h_{n+1}(d^nF)(g_1,...,g_n)(x) by first applying d^nF to (x,g_1,...,g_n) and then evaluating the resulting D(M)-valued cochain at 1. The first summand is F(g_1,...,g_n)(x), the next n summands are the negatives and alternating products that match the interior terms from the preceding expansion, and the last summand is (-1)^{n+1}F(x,g_1,...,g_{n-1})(1). This is a direct substitution into the displayed definitions.

source.place: Tag 0DVG, label section-continuous-group-cohomology; direct expansion of the inhomogeneous differential

proof.text: Add the two displayed expansions. Every term involving F with an inserted product g_jg_{j+1}, and every endpoint term F(x,g_1,...,g_{n-1})(1), occurs twice with opposite signs; the sole uncancelled term is F(g_1,...,g_n)(x). Since this equality holds for every x and every (g_1,...,g_n), it is the equality of continuous cochains d^{n-1}h_nF+h_{n+1}d^nF=F.

split_report.summary: Split the coinduced contraction identity into pointwise expansion of d^{n-1}h_n, pointwise expansion of h_{n+1}d^n, and the alternating-sign cancellation. The existing continuity and coinduced-action statements are cited exactly where used; the remaining algebra is elementary.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the final continuous-cochain comparison clause of def-exc-continuous-cohomology: the three steps are the direct evaluation, expansion, and cancellation establishing the contraction identity.
